What We Do

Groundwork & surfacing, start to finish

From a fresh driveway to full site groundworks, we handle the dig, the base and the finish - no subcontractors, no shortcuts.

Block Paving

Hard-wearing block paved driveways and paths, laid on a properly compacted base with crisp edging detail.

Learn more →

Tarmac Drives

Smooth, durable tarmac surfacing for driveways and larger areas, finished with block or stone edge restraint.

Learn more →

Patios & Slabbing

Indian sandstone, porcelain and paving slab patios that turn the back garden into proper usable space.

Learn more →

Drop Kerbs

Vehicle crossings and dropped kerbs to get safe, legal access onto your new driveway.

Learn more →

Fencing

Closeboard, panel and post-and-rail fencing with concrete posts - fitted square, solid and built to weather.

Learn more →

Drainage & Groundworks

Soakaways, channel drainage and full site groundworks to keep surfaces compliant and water where it belongs.

Learn more →
The Difference

Real transformations

Watch the difference for yourself. Every job below was completed entirely by our own team - no contractors, ever.

Driveway Transformation

Block paving driveway, done properly

A cracked, tired frontage stripped right back and rebuilt on a solid, free-draining sub-base, then finished in crisp block paving. Smart, hard-wearing kerb appeal that's built to last.

Driveway Transformation

Excavated and rebuilt from the ground up

What started as a worn, uneven surface was fully excavated, re-levelled and rebuilt on a solid base, then laid in warm-toned block paving with a tidy border - a low-maintenance drive that lasts.

Patio Transformation

A garden patio transformed for outdoor living

A muddy, unusable rear garden levelled and laid with contemporary porcelain paving, framed by clean timber-edged borders - a smart, low-maintenance space ready to enjoy.
